non_blocking_findings.title: Native dataset factory also constructs an unused validation dataset
non_blocking_findings.details: TrainTester.get_datasets(args) creates split=train at train_dist_mod.py:2892 and also split=val at :2938. Only the returned train object is wrapped by Subset(range(16)); there is no validation iterator, loss, inference, or accuracy computation in the check. Thus no validation sample is used for optimization, but a claim of zero validation-file access would be false. This also adds native validation-construction I/O and memory.
non_blocking_findings.minimal_action: Keep the scope statement precise. A direct call to the same native training dataset constructor is the minimal change if zero validation-file access is intended.

audit_checks.topic: Saved state and honest restore scope
